# Pull Request

## Summary

Explain what changed and why.

## Type of Change

- [ ] New skill
- [ ] Skill improvement
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Tooling/script
- [ ] Repository maintenance

## Checklist

- [ ] I ran `npm run validate`
- [ ] I ran `npm run catalog`
- [ ] The skill has clear activation criteria
- [ ] The skill includes workflow, guardrails, and output contract
- [ ] The README/catalog is still accurate
